# Trusted Locksmith

> Business locksmith coordination for property managers, landlords, rental operators and real-estate businesses. Operated by PlanetHike OÜ.

## Scope and availability
- B2B only. New consumer booking and household membership enrollment are closed.
- Boston and Greater Boston, Massachusetts are the primary launch market. Northeast expansion pages are enquiry locations, not evidence of active coverage.
- Participating independent locksmiths perform field work. Every address, provider, appointment and project scope requires confirmation. No emergency response-time guarantee is advertised.
- Master-key and commercial access-control content is planning guidance. Specialist coverage and suitability must be confirmed before any commitment.

## Standard price examples (USD)
- Rekey: $75 including travel/service call and the first standard cylinder; $29 per additional standard cylinder.
- Lock change: $89 labor including travel for one standard residential lock at a managed property; hardware separate.
- Smart lock: $129 labor including travel for one compatible customer-supplied smart lock; hardware, modification, electrical work and network troubleshooting excluded.
- These are this platform's own published standard prices, not market averages. Specialty work and applicable taxes must be confirmed in the quotation.
- Standard rekey pricing does not cover master-key design or commercial access-control installations.

Consult the linked page for current terms. This file is a discovery aid, not a service commitment or guarantee of search-engine inclusion.
